messages.text: Hi I was just wondering if there was any news on when the Harlo Pool might be back up?

I don't have a confirmed date for the Harlo Pool coming back up, and I won't guess at one.

I've passed it to Georges so you get a straight answer on it. He'll pick it up right here, and if you step away it comes to your email.

If you're mining in the meantime, I'm happy to help you point a unit at another pool, or talk through what's in stock.
